title: Munazera
body:
Munazera
Ek mufti muje dosto kal raat mila tha
mehdi ka mukhalif tha ye chehre pe likha tha
Imaan pe mere zarb lagane pe tula tha
<<DIVIDER>>
mai uske irade pe bohot dil me hasa tha
Kehta tha ye ghaybat muje afsana lage hai
Maine kaha tu bhi muje deewana lage hai
Har chiz nazar aaye zaruri nahi mufti
<<DIVIDER>>
Hoore bhi nahi dekhi hai imaan hai phir bhi
Ashabe kahf per bhi tuje shak nahi koi
Phir kyu na zahanat bhi hase aql pe teri
Tu jisko gumaan maan raha hai wo yaqeen hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Shaytan ka qael to hai Mehdi ka nahi hai
Ye Sunke hi marne laga wo bugz ka maara
baaz aaya nahi fir bhi wo shaytan ka pyara
Ek baar kiya fir use zillat ne ishara
<<DIVIDER>>
Aur haath rakhe dil pe wo chillaya bichara
Is waqt bata mujko tera mehdi kaha hai
Maine kaha Allah jaha hai wo waha hai
Ye sunke wo kehne laga tauba ha re tauba
<<DIVIDER>>
Mehdi ko tu Allah ke jaisa hai samajta
Maine kaha Padh likh ke bhi jaahil hai tu beta
Kya khaak teri aql ne Allah ko jaana
Gar uska wali Haaziro naaziro nahi hoga
<<DIVIDER>>
Allah ke hone ka pata kaise chalega
author: Shahid Baltistani
